Entries.Literal: "Eye tracking has been unreliable for the last minute — consider repositioning, or recalibrating in Tobii."
"The user has been struggling continuously — consider checking in."
"Tracking may have drifted — consider recalibrating in Tobii"
"Select a window — or look away to cancel"
"Restart failed: EyeCtrl could not determine its own program path. "
"Restart failed: the new EyeCtrl closed immediately. "
"Restart failed: the new EyeCtrl could not be started. "

"Turn off another action's \"on first layer\" switch to free a slot."
"Reset the learned adaptation offsets to zero?"
"It changes nothing and always ends with \u201Crecorded\u201D; run it when you are rested."
"Measure gaze offset records where your gaze lands at five points. "
"Circle Color is not used by the Achromatic reticle ring style."
"A recording is a trace of where you looked and when — nothing about what you were "
"looking at. It stays on this computer, in your EyeCtrl folder, until you delete it."
"A changed theme applies after a restart."
"A supervisor is installed. It restarts EyeCtrl if it ever fails, and can recover "
"Reset ALL settings to defaults?\nThis cannot be undone."
"a restart that goes wrong.\nStarting it turns supervision on and leaves it on."
"if it keeps failing, TD Control opens instead."
"the EyeCtrl Supervisor is not installed on this PC."
"No learned words yet. They collect as you type; the Add Word key (Fn row) adds one on the spot."
"Removed for this session, but the dictionary file could not be updated."
$"Removed “{captured}” for this session, but the dictionary file could not be updated."
$"Re-download {e3.DisplayName} ({FormatSize(e3.SizeBytes)})? This replaces the files on disk."

"Waiting for the new EyeCtrl to start. If it cannot, this one keeps running.\n"
"A fallback eye-control app has been launched. Use it (or a mouse) to choose an option below."
"(Reordering is out of scope for this build; the default order above is shown.)"
"Watchdog that keeps EyeCtrl running and falls back to another eye-control app if it crashes."
"When EyeCtrl crashes repeatedly, the supervisor launches the first installed app in this list."
"Supervision enabled. (Scheduled Task install is a separate step.)"
"Calibration produced a distorted transform (gaze would be flipped or amplified). Please recalibrate."
"Calibration produced an unusable transform — gaze would map off-screen. Please recalibrate."
"Gaze barely changed across calibration targets — the eye tracker may not be tracking. Please recalibrate."
"Something went wrong while calibrating. Please try again."
"Try again and rest on each point until its ring fills — looking away resets nothing, "
